decision: FAIL at 19 of 24 evaluations: no cell of the G1a x G3 x G4 matrix (G1b and G2 at candidate values) meets the count row at both calibration inputs; the closest are 001 (24/43) and 000 (26/45). The passive/threshold family is the sub-system outside G1-G4 named by the residual pattern.

prediction_check.c-m010 fewer than 10 at both: held at 0.19 (7); 11 at 0.27, one above the stated bound

causal_structure.G1a sodium inactivation (h_close 0.15): Necessary and sufficient, within this partition, for the human-like first spike: every cell with G1a has peak within 4.4 mV and duration within 0.05 ms; every cell without it has peak +23 mV and duration +0.47 ms. The same change raises every recovery minimum by about +6 mV (cells with G1a: +5.8 to +11.4 mV; without: -0.02 to +2.2 mV) and raises excitability so that, without G4, the cell blocks at 0.27 nA (100: 4 events; 110: 4 events).
causal_structure.G4 somatic NaTg x1.1 with Ca_LVA x0.5: Necessary, given G1a, to sustain firing at 0.27 nA (110 vs 111: 4 vs 59; 100 vs 101: 4 vs 143). Alone it changes counts by at most 2 events.
causal_structure.G3 axonal calcium decay 300 ms with gamm: The brake on both counts: removing it from the candidate gives 84/143; adding it to the source gives 5/8. Its dose sets the count level but not the count ratio.
causal_structure.G1b h_slope 5: No measurable effect under the recorded input (counts unchanged, RSS smallest in every group).
causal_structure.G2 somatic Kv3 gating x0.5: Largest complete RSS on the minima among the cells that keep every event; does not reverse the +6 mV shift that G1a introduces.

gain_finding: Every one of the eight cells has a 0.27/0.19 count ratio between 0.04 and 2.3 against the human 3.6, and every cell leaves the four passive samples +2.0 to +4.1 mV above the human values. A threshold set by leak, leak reversal, or Ih under the recorded bias is the only family in the model that moves the low-input count without the high-input count; it is outside G1-G4 and was not tested.
reassessment_for_the_user: Approve or decline a bounded passive-family split on the 001 cell (G1b+G2+G4 on the source: 24/43 events, minima within 2.1 mV, shape wrong) and on 000, with 5 evaluations in reserve: leak conductance and leak reversal doses chosen to bring the -0.11 nA and -0.05 nA samples within 1 mV, then read the 0.19 nA count.

Establish from the ModelDB 267587 fitting protocol whether the published HL5BN1 fit applied the 31.4 pA bias; if it did not, the source itself was fitted against a different input and the model family question stands.

The diagnostic H01 closing-time override (h_close 0.15 -> 1.0) is the G1a member: removing it removes the human-like spike shape here, so the H01 override and the donor shape error are the same lever seen from two sides.
